value.thesis: Brad Gerstner (All-In Podcast) believes NVIDIA at 14x next year's earnings is not a bubble, supported by lab revenue roughly doubling and buildout executing, though he expects closer to 25 gigawatts next year against a 43-gigawatt forecast.
Dan Niles (RiskReversal) views Meta as a dark-horse beneficiary of AI spending via consumer distribution.

Ali Ghodsi (Databricks CEO, Long Strange Trip) discusses beating Snowflake through Databricks' open format and claimed 3x TCO edge.
